campaigns.title: Make Your Own Myth
campaigns.format: Bold typographic OOH + 15s social + on-trade tastings
campaigns.body: Three thousand years of Greek glory, slow-aged in oak and handed to you. Pour it neat. Pour it loud. Just pour it like you mean it. Kléos. Drink responsibly. 18+.
campaigns.outcome: Outsold launch target by 60% in on-trade; won a design award for the OOH typography; 0 deep-discount activity.
campaigns.why_it_worked: Heritage swagger without the dust. The craft detail (slow-aged in oak) earned the boast; responsibility line kept it clean.

campaigns.title: To the Ones Who Earn It
campaigns.body: Here's to the early mornings and the long odds. To the ones who build something worth toasting. Raise a glass of Kléos — you earned it. Enjoy responsibly. 18+.
campaigns.outcome: 38% email open rate, top-performing CRM campaign of the year; strong reshare rate on the hero line.
campaigns.why_it_worked: Tied the brand's 'earned glory' value to the audience's own grind. Proud, witty, and on-myth.

campaigns.title: What the Oak Knows
campaigns.body: Years in Greek oak. Copper stills that have seen a few centuries. No shortcuts, no apologies — just fire that took its time. Kléos. Drink responsibly. 18+.
campaigns.outcome: Drove listings in 120+ premium bars; trade NPS for the brand rose sharply post-campaign.
campaigns.why_it_worked: Spoke to the trade as peers with real craft proof, while keeping the confident, unfussy Kléos bite.
